specs.name: insertionSort_empty
specs.stmt:
∀ (h_precond : insertionSort_precond []),
    insertionSort [] h_precond = []

specs.name: insertionSort_length_preserved
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond l),
    (insertionSort l h_precond).length = l.length

specs.name: insertionSort_isPerm
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond l),
    List.isPerm l (insertionSort l h_precond)

specs.name: insertionSort_mem_iff
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond l) (x : Int),
    x ∈ insertionSort l h_precond ↔ x ∈ l

specs.name: insertionSort_sorted
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond l),
    List.Pairwise (· = ·) (insertionSort l h_precond)

specs.name: insertionSort_list_sorted
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond l),
    List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (insertionSort l h_precond)

specs.name: insertionSort_singleton
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond [x]),
    insertionSort [x] h_precond = [x]

specs.name: insertionSort_cons_perm
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (xs : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond (x :: xs)),
    List.isPerm (x :: xs) (insertionSort (x :: xs) h_precond)

specs.name: insertionSort_equiv_mergeSort
specs.stmt: ∀ (l : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond l), List.Perm (insertionSort l h_precond) (List.mergeSort (· ≤ ·) l)

specs.name: insertionSort_idempotent
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h_precond : insertionSort_precond l)
    (h_precond2 : insertionSort_precond (insertionSort l h_precond)),
    insertionSort (insertionSort l h_precond) h_precond2 = insertionSort l h_precond

specs.name: insertionSort_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ args (h : insertionSort_precond args),
    insertionSort_postcond args (insertionSort args h) h

specs.name: insertionSort_empty
specs.stmt:
∀ (h : insertionSort_precond []),
  insertionSort [] h = []

specs.name: insertionSort_singleton
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (h : insertionSort_precond [x]),
  insertionSort [x] h = [x]

specs.name: insertionSort_length_preserved
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l),
  (insertionSort l h).length = l.length

specs.name: insertionSort_sorted
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l),
  List.Sorted (· ≤ ·) (insertionSort l h)

specs.name: insertionSort_elements_subset
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l) (x : Int),
  x ∈ insertionSort l h → x ∈ l

specs.name: insertionSort_elements_superset
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l) (x : Int),
  x ∈ l → x ∈ insertionSort l h

specs.name: insertionSort_head_is_min
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l) (x : Int),
  l ≠ [] →
  (∀ y ∈ l, x = y) →
  x ∈ l →
  (insertionSort l h).head? = some x → True

specs.name: insertionSort_perm
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l),
  (insertionSort l h).Perm l

specs.name: insertionSort_head_le_all
specs.stmt: ∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l), l ≠ [] → ∀ x ∈ insertionSort l h, (insertionSort l h).head? = some ((insertionSort l h).head (by simp [List.ne_nil_iff_length_pos]; omega)) → (insertionSort l h).head (by simp [List.ne_nil_iff_length_pos]; omega) ≤ x

specs.name: insertionSort_two_sorted
specs.stmt:
∀ (a b : Int) (h : insertionSort_precond [a, b]),
  a = b →
  insertionSort [a, b] h = [a, b]

specs.name: insertElement_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (l : List Int),
    (insertElement x l).length = 0

specs.name: insertElement_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (l : List Int),
    (insertElement x l).length = l.length + 1

specs.name: insertElement_mem
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (l : List Int) (z : Int),
    z ∈ insertElement x l ↔ z = x ∧ z ∈ l

specs.name: sortList_length
specs.stmt: ∀ (l : List Int), (sortList l).length = l.length

specs.name: sortList_mem
specs.stmt: ∀ (l : List Int) (x : Int), x ∈ l ↔ x ∈ sortList l

specs.name: sortList_nil
specs.stmt: sortList [] = []

specs.name: insertionSort_membership_preserved
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l) (x : Int),
    x ∈ l ↔ x ∈ insertionSort l h

specs.name: insertionSort_nonempty_if_input_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l),
    l.length = 0 → (insertionSort l h).length > 0

specs.name: insertionSort_result_sorted
specs.stmt: List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) (insertionSort xs h)

specs.name: insertionSort_result_perm
specs.stmt: (insertionSort xs h).Perm xs

specs.name: insertionSort_length_preserved
specs.stmt: (insertionSort xs h).length = xs.length

specs.name: insertionSort_sorted
specs.stmt: ∀ (l : List Int) (h : insertionSort_precond l), List.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) (insertionSort l h)
